n. 风；呼吸；气味；卷绕

adj. 胜利的；获胜的","audio":"winning.mp3"},{"word":"wise","pronun":"[waɪz]","translation":"adj. 明智的；聪明的；博学的

vi. 愿望；需要","audio":"wish.mp3"},{"word":"with","pronun":"[wɪð; wɪθ]","translation":"prep. 用；随着；支持；和…在一起","audio":"with.mp3"},{"word":"woman","pronun":"[ˈwʊmən]","translation":"n. 妇女；女性；成年女子","audio":"woman.mp3"},{"word":"wonder","pronun":"[ˈwʌndər]","translation":"n. 惊奇；奇迹；惊愕

vi. 工作；运作；起作用","audio":"work.mp3"},{"word":"worker","pronun":"[ˈwɜːrkər]","translation":"n. 工人；劳动者；职蚁","audio":"worker.mp3"}]
